company.description: Diffusion is a software engineering and financial risk research company focused on blockchain, digital assets, and finance-related technologies. The company develops high-performance software systems, research tools, and infrastructure for decentralized finance and digital asset ecosystems. Its work includes risk analysis, blockchain applications, and scalable technology solutions designed for finance and Web3 environments.
